**1 — Scene:** A cheese-and-tomato-sauce-topped pasta roll or similar baked dish, sliced poultry, and a mixed salad. Water is also visible.

**2 — Vessels:** The main plate and shallow salad bowl appear approximately **23 cm across** each. Estimated area of each: 3.14 × 11.5² = **415 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Cheese-topped baked roll with tomato sauce; sliced chicken or turkey breast; leafy greens; tomato and cucumber pieces; a light oily salad dressing. The roll’s cheese and sauce are included in its estimate.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy:**

| Item | Vessel coverage | Area × height = gross volume | Density → weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---|---:|---:|

| Sliced poultry breast | 18% of main plate | 75 cm² × 1.3 cm = 98 ml | 0.95 → **93 g** | 150 | 140 kcal |
| Leafy greens | 35% of salad bowl | 145 cm² × 2 cm = 290 ml | 0.15 → **44 g** | 20 | 9 kcal |
| Tomato and cucumber | 22% of salad bowl | 91 cm² × 1 cm = 91 ml | 0.6 → **55 g** | 20 | 11 kcal |
| Oily dressing | Thin coating, overlapping salad | Approximately 4 ml | 1.0 → **4 g** | 880 | 35 kcal |

Coverage totals are **46% of the main plate** and **57% of the salad bowl**. Dressing overlaps the vegetables rather than adding a separate footprint.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **395 g of food and 613 kcal** is plausible for the visible baked portion, modest poultry serving, and light salad. The baked dish’s identity and filling are the largest uncertainties. Water contributes no calories and is excluded from food weight.
